defective_pattern: Placing asterisks (*) in non-correlation tables, including markdown italic wrapper remnants inside table cells or redundant significance stars alongside exact p-values.
why_defective: Renders literal asterisks in table cells, confuses readers, and violates APA 7 parsimony guidelines where exact p-values are already reported.
observed_symptoms: Raw * characters inside table headers like (*خودآسیبی*)
Asterisks attached to regression beta or t coefficients when exact p-values are tabulated
corrective_remedy: Whitelist only correlation matrix tables for asterisks; enforce pure clean Persian construct names in table headers and row labels.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of '*' characters inside table cells (header or body) that do not belong to a valid correlation matrix structure.
